' DEFENDER HELLGATE - DEFENDER HYPERSPACE (Stargate's Defender) crossed with MECHRA's bullet hell,
' for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC. (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Everything DEFENDER HYPERSPACE has (the planet 2048 pixels round, landers, mutants, the full
' Stargate cast, the Stargate and its warp, Inviso, smart bombs, hyperspace, the planet blowing
' up when the humanoids are all gone), plus MECHRA's: what you shoot drops pickups (P, big P,
' gems) that fly to you when you're close; ten P is a power level (up to 5: more lasers, angled,
' faster); GUARD eats every bullet on the screen; kills in quick succession build a HIT chain.
' The enemies shoot more, and in rings, as the level goes up.
' The level: it starts at 1 and goes up every time 8 more humanoids are saved (still alive at the
' end of a wave). Every third level, a boss level: the ground stays, the humanoids are kept safe
' out of the way, and a giant mech fills the sky with bullets. Each boss is worth more. The game
' never ends: the levels just keep going up.
'
' Keys: Q A up and down, O P left and right (or 5 6 7 8, or a joystick). Space (or M, fire): laser.
'       B (or Enter, fire 2): smart bomb. G: guard. I (or N): Inviso. H: hyperspace.
'
' The planet is Layer 2, drawn a column at a time as it comes into view and scrolled by the copper
' (Land.cls); the ship, the enemies, the humanoids, the pickups and the explosions are sprites; the
' bullets and your laser are moved and checked in Z80 (Bul.cls); the scanner and the panel are the
' tilemap.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const WORLD = 2048, HALF = 1024
Const NU = 24, NP = 10, NB = 8, NBOX = 24, NI = 6
' sprite slots (Bul has 54-127): the enemies 2-25 (in a boss level 2-13; the boss 14-25), the
' pickups 26-31, the guard 32
Const SP_SHIP = 0, SP_UFO = 2, SP_BOSS = 14, SP_ITEM = 26, SP_GUARD = 32, SP_PEOPLE = 34, SP_BOOM = 44, SP_WIN = 52, SP_GATE = 53
' palette rows: the pickups and the guard, the first giant mech
Const PAL_ITEM = 8, PAL_BOSS = 9
' the enemies
Const K_LANDER = 1, K_MUTANT = 2, K_BOMBER = 3, K_POD = 4, K_SWARM = 5, K_BAITER = 6, K_FIREB = 7
Const K_FIREBALL = 8, K_DYNAMO = 9, K_HUM = 10, K_GUPPY = 11, K_PHRED = 12, K_BIGRED = 13, K_MUNCH = 14
' where you can fly (paper rows; the scanner is above), where the humanoids stand
Const YTOP = 44, YLOW = 176, GY = 177
Const PINK = 2, BLUE = 3
' the Stargate
Const GATEX = 1500, GATEY = 84

Dim longText As String Max 80
' the enemies: kind, x (world pixels), y, x speed (8ths), y speed, a timer, who they've got (-1
' none), when they fire next, x's 8ths, their box (-1 none)
Dim uk(23) As Integer, ux(23) As Integer, uy(23) As Integer, uvx(23) As Integer, uvy(23) As Integer
Dim ut(23) As Integer, ug(23) As Integer, uf(23) As Integer, ufr(23) As Integer, ub(23) As Integer
' a lander's humanoid in its sights (-1 none)
Dim utg(23) As Integer
' the scanner's row and the dot's place in it, for each row of the screen
Dim scR(255) As Byte, scS(255) As Byte
' to come this wave, by kind
Dim q(14) As Integer
' the humanoids: 0 gone, 1 walking, 2 carried up, 3 falling, 4 aboard your ship; x, y, way,
' fall speed, where they fell from, their box, their place aboard
Dim ps(9) As Integer, px(9) As Integer, py(9) As Integer, pd(9) As Integer, pv(9) As Integer
Dim pf(9) As Integer, pb(9) As Integer, pa(9) As Integer
' the hit boxes: who has each (-1 free)
Dim bo(23) As Integer
Dim bx(7) As Integer, by(7) As Integer, bt(7) As Integer, bnext As Integer
' you: x (8ths of a world pixel), y, speed (8ths a frame), facing
Dim hx As Integer, hy As Integer, hvx As Integer, face As Integer, alive As Integer, safe As Integer, deadT As Integer, cool As Integer
Dim smart As Integer, smartT As Integer, smartWas As Integer, hyperWas As Integer, hyperT As Integer, thrust As Integer
Dim aboard As Integer, catches As Integer, cloak As Integer, cloakOn As Integer, gateT As Integer, warp As Integer
Dim camX As Integer, pan As Integer
Dim score As Long, hiscore As Long, lives As Integer, wave As Integer, over As Integer, nextLife As Long
Dim frames As Integer, msgT As Integer, scoreDirty As Integer, waveT As Integer, planetGone As Integer, lastBonus As Long
Dim chaser As Integer, att As Integer, tc As Integer, me As Integer, nuMax As Integer
' MECHRA's side: the power level (1-5), P toward the next, P altogether (a guard every 25), guards
' left and the one running, the HIT chain; the level, the humanoids saved toward the next, the
' bosses beaten
Dim power As Integer, pNext As Integer, pAll As Integer, guards As Integer, guardT As Integer, guardWas As Integer
Dim chain As Integer, chainT As Integer, level As Integer, saved As Integer, bossDone As Integer, statsDirty As Integer
' the pickups: kind (0 none, 1 P, 2 big P, 3 gem), x (world), y (16ths), speeds (16ths), age
Dim ik(5) As Integer, ix(5) As Integer, iy(5) As Integer, ivx(5) As Integer, ivy(5) As Integer, ia(5) As Integer
' the boss: its screen x, y, life, full life, timer, which giant mech, its box, dying
Dim bsx As Integer, bsy As Integer, bossHP As Integer, bossMax As Integer, bossT As Integer, bossN As Integer
Dim bossBox As Integer, bossDie As Integer, bossFl As Integer
' Sine1 divided by 2, 4, 24, 32; the scanner's column and dot for each 16 pixels from its left edge
Dim sn2(127) As Integer, sn4(127) As Integer, sn24(127) As Integer, sn32(127) As Integer
Dim scC(127) As Byte, scD(127) As Byte
Dim i As Integer, k As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Land.Init
Bul.Init GfxData.S_LASER
Bul.Limits 2000, 2000                   ' (the planet joins up end to end: no ends to stop at)
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSUL                    ' sprites over the panel, the panel over the planet
Nx.Reg &H1C, 2                           ' the sprites cut to the paper (x halved: over the border)
Nx.Reg &H19, 16 : Nx.Reg &H19, 143 : Nx.Reg &H19, 32 : Nx.Reg &H19, 223
Nx.Reg &H15, Nx.RegGet(&H15) Or &H20
hiscore = 21270
For i = 0 To 255
  k = (i - 40) * 9 \ 145
  If k < 0 Then k = 0
  If k > 8 Then k = 8
  scR(i) = 5 + k \ 3 : scS(i) = (k Mod 3) * 4
Next
For i = 0 To 127
  k = Sine1(i)
  sn2(i) = k \ 2 : sn4(i) = k \ 4 : sn24(i) = k \ 24 : sn32(i) = k \ 32
Next
For i = 0 To 127
  scC(i) = 4 + i \ 4 : scD(i) = i And 3
Next
Do
  Title
  Game
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the world joins up end to end
' where world x is on the screen (its paper x: -1024 .. 1023)
Function Sx(ByVal x As Integer) As Integer
  Sx = ((x - camX + WORLD + HALF) And (WORLD - 1)) - HALF
End Function

' from a to b the short way round (-1024 .. 1023)
Function Dif(ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer) As Integer
  Dif = ((b - a + WORLD + HALF) And (WORLD - 1)) - HALF
End Function

Function Wrap(ByVal x As Integer) As Integer
  Wrap = (x + WORLD) And (WORLD - 1)
End Function

' a frame on: the counter kept 0 - 32767 (past that an Integer goes negative)
Sub Tick()
  frames = (frames + 1) And &H7FFF
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the panel and the scanner
Sub Hud()
  Tiles.Fill 0
  Tiles.Rect 0, 0, 40, 4, GfxData.T_HUD
  Tiles.Rect 4, 4, 32, 1, GfxData.T_SCANT
  Tiles.Rect 4, 5, 32, 2, GfxData.T_SCAN
  Tiles.Rect 4, 7, 32, 1, GfxData.T_SCANG
  Tiles.Rect 3, 4, 1, 4, GfxData.T_SCANS
  Tiles.Rect 36, 4, 1, 4, GfxData.T_SCANS
  Tiles.Text 4, 1, "SCORE"
  Tiles.Text 19, 1, "HI " & Right$("000000" & Trim$(Str$(hiscore)), 7)
  Tiles.Text 30, 1, "WAVE " & Trim$(Str$(wave))
  Tiles.Text 20, 2, "INV"
  ShowScore
  ShowLives
  ShowCloak
  ShowStats
End Sub

' the bottom line of the panel: the level, the power, guards, the HIT chain
Sub ShowStats()
  Dim n As Integer
  longText = "LV " & Trim$(Str$(level)) & "   "
  Tiles.Text 4, 3, Left$(longText, 6)
  Tiles.Text 10, 3, "POW" & Trim$(Str$(power))
  For n = 0 To 9
    If n < pNext Then Tiles.Put 15 + n, 3, GfxData.T_INV Else Tiles.Put 15 + n, 3, GfxData.T_INVE
  Next
  Tiles.Text 26, 3, "G" & Trim$(Str$(guards)) & " "
  If chain > 1 Then
    longText = "HIT " & Trim$(Str$(chain)) & "   "
  Else
    longText = "        "
  End If
  Tiles.Text 30, 3, Left$(longText, 8)
  statsDirty = 0
End Sub

Sub ShowScore()
  Tiles.Text 10, 1, Right$("000000" & Trim$(Str$(score)), 7)
  scoreDirty = 0
End Sub

Sub ShowLives()
  For k = 0 To 5
    If k < lives Then Tiles.Put 4 + k, 2, GfxData.T_LIFE Else Tiles.Put 4 + k, 2, GfxData.T_HUD
    If k < smart Then Tiles.Put 12 + k, 2, GfxData.T_SMART Else Tiles.Put 12 + k, 2, GfxData.T_HUD
  Next
End Sub

' the Inviso left: 10 blocks, 40 frames each
Sub ShowCloak()
  Dim n As Integer
  n = (cloak + 39) \ 40
  For k = 0 To 9
    If k < n Then Tiles.Put 24 + k, 2, GfxData.T_INV Else Tiles.Put 24 + k, 2, GfxData.T_INVE
  Next
End Sub

Sub AddScore(ByVal n As Long)
  score = score + n
  scoreDirty = 1
  If score >= nextLife Then
    ' every 10,000: a ship, a smart bomb, more Inviso
    nextLife = nextLife + 10000
    lives = lives + 1 : smart = smart + 1
    cloak = cloak + 120
    If cloak > 400 Then cloak = 400
    ShowLives : ShowCloak
    Sfx.Play 1, 60, -1, 14, 30, 0
  End If
End Sub

' a message across the middle for t frames (0: until the next)
Sub Message(ByVal m As String, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  longText = m
  Tiles.Rect 4, y, 32, 1, 0
  Tiles.Text 4 + (32 - Len(longText)) \ 2, y, longText
  If t Then msgT = t
End Sub

Sub ClearMessages()
  Tiles.Rect 4, 9, 32, 18, 0
End Sub

' the scanner: the whole planet in 256 pixels (8 to 1), with you in the middle; every 4th frame
Sub Scanner()
  Dim n As Integer, base As Integer
  If (frames And 3) <> 1 Then Exit Sub
  Tiles.Rect 4, 5, 32, 2, GfxData.T_SCAN
  Tiles.Rect 4, 7, 32, 1, GfxData.T_SCANG
  base = Wrap(me - HALF)
  Dot base, GATEX, GATEY, 4
  For n = 0 To NP - 1
    If ps(n) > 0 And ps(n) < 4 Then Dot base, px(n), py(n), 3
  Next
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uk(n) = K_LANDER Then
      Dot base, ux(n), uy(n), 1
    ElseIf uk(n) Then
      Dot base, ux(n), uy(n), 0
    End If
  Next
  If alive Then Dot base, me, hy, 2
  ' the part on the screen
  Spr.Put SP_WIN, ((camX - base) And (WORLD - 1)) \ 8 + 32, 44, GfxData.S_WINDOW, Spr.Scale2X
End Sub

Sub Dot(ByVal base As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  Dim r As Integer
  r = ((x - base) And (WORLD - 1)) \ 16
  y = y And 255
  Tiles.Put scC(r), scR(y), GfxData.T_DOT + c * 12 + scS(y) + scD(r)
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Function FireDown() As Integer
  FireDown = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or ((Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
End Function

' one of the cast: its sprite at tile column cx, row cy, its name and points beside it
Sub Cast(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal cx As Integer, ByVal cy As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal fl As Integer, ByVal nm As String)
  Spr.Put SP_UFO + n, cx * 8 - 4, cy * 8 - 4, pat, fl
  Tiles.Text cx + 2, cy, nm
End Sub

Sub Title()
  Dim t As Integer, page As Integer, a As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 54 : Spr.Show
  Bul.Reset : Bul.Show
  wave = 1 : lives = 3 : score = 0 : smart = 3 : cloak = 200 : planetGone = 0
  level = 1 : power = 1 : guards = 3 : pNext = 0 : chain = 0
  Land.Kill 0
  Hud
  t = 0 : page = 0 : camX = 0 : face = 1 : hy = 100
  Do
    If t = 0 Then
      ' the pages: the cast, then the keys
      Spr.HideRange 2, 52
      ClearMessages
      Message "D E F E N D E R", 9, 0
      Message "H E L L G A T E", 10, 0
      If page = 0 Then
        Cast 0, 5, 13, GfxData.S_LANDER, 0, "LANDER    150"
        Cast 1, 5, 15, GfxData.S_MUTANT, 0, "MUTANT    150"
        Cast 2, 5, 17, GfxData.S_BOMBER, 0, "BOMBER    250"
        Cast 3, 5, 19, GfxData.S_POD, 0, "POD      1000"
        Cast 4, 5, 21, GfxData.S_SWARMER, 0, "SWARMER   150"
        Cast 5, 5, 23, GfxData.S_BAITER, 0, "BAITER    200"
        Cast 6, 5, 25, GfxData.S_FIREB, 0, "FIREBOMBER 250"
        Cast 7, 21, 13, GfxData.S_FIREBALL, 0, "FIREBALL 100"
        Cast 8, 21, 15, GfxData.S_DYNAMO, 0, "DYNAMO   200"
        Cast 9, 21, 17, GfxData.S_HUM, 0, "SPACE HUM 100"
        Cast 10, 21, 19, GfxData.S_GUPPY, 0, "GUPPY    200"
        Cast 11, 21, 21, GfxData.S_PHRED, 0, "PHRED    200"
        Cast 12, 21, 23, GfxData.S_PHRED, Spr.Pal * 6, "BIG RED  200"
        Cast 13, 21, 25, GfxData.S_MUNCHIE, 0, "MUNCHIE   50"
      Else
        Message "QA UP/DOWN   OP LEFT/RIGHT", 13, 0
        Message "(OR 5678, OR A JOYSTICK)", 14, 0
        Message "SPACE LASER   B SMART BOMB", 16, 0
        Message "G GUARD  I INVISO  H HYPERSPACE", 17, 0
        Message "SAVE THE HUMANOIDS: EVERY 8", 19, 0
        Message "SAVED IS A LEVEL. EVERY THIRD", 20, 0
        Message "LEVEL, A GIANT MECH ATTACKS.", 21, 0
        Message "PICK UP P FOR POWER. 25 P: A GUARD", 23, 0
        Message "(C) 2026 CYBORG UNICORN", 26, 0
        Cast 0, 4, 23, GfxData.S_ITEM, Spr.Pal * PAL_ITEM, ""
        Cast 1, 35, 23, GfxData.S_BIGP, Spr.Pal * PAL_ITEM, ""
      End If
    End If
    ' the stars and the mountains going by, a ship flying through
    camX = Wrap(camX + 2)
    Land.View camX
    If page = 0 Then
      Spr.Put SP_SHIP, (t * 2) Mod 320 - 40, 92, GfxData.S_SHIP + 2 + ((frames \ 2) And 1) * 2, 0
      Spr.Put SP_SHIP + 1, (t * 2) Mod 320 - 24, 92, GfxData.S_SHIP + 3 + ((frames \ 2) And 1) * 2, 0
      ' the cast moving
      If (frames And 7) = 0 Then
        a = (frames \ 8) And 1
        Spr.Put SP_UFO, 36, 100, GfxData.S_LANDER + a, 0
        Spr.Put SP_UFO + 1, 36, 116, GfxData.S_MUTANT + a, 0
        Spr.Put SP_UFO + 3, 36, 148, GfxData.S_POD + a, 0
        Spr.Put SP_UFO + 6, 36, 196, GfxData.S_FIREB + a, 0
        Spr.Put SP_UFO + 8, 164, 116, GfxData.S_DYNAMO + a, 0
        Spr.Put SP_UFO + 10, 164, 148, GfxData.S_GUPPY + a, 0
        Spr.Put SP_UFO + 11, 164, 164, GfxData.S_PHRED + a, 0
        Spr.Put SP_UFO + 12, 164, 180, GfxData.S_PHRED + a, Spr.Pal * 6
      End If
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_SHIP : Spr.Hide SP_SHIP + 1
    End If
    If (frames And 15) = 0 Then Land.Twinkle frames \ 16
    Frame
    Land.Upload
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    Tick
    t = t + 1
    If (t Mod 50) = 0 Then
      If (t \ 50) Mod 2 Then Message "PRESS SPACE", 28, 0 Else Tiles.Rect 4, 28, 32, 1, 0
    End If
    If t = 400 Then t = 0 : page = 1 - page
  Loop Until FireDown()
  Do
    Frame
  Loop While FireDown()
  ClearMessages
  Tiles.Rect 4, 28, 32, 1, 0
  Spr.HideRange 0, 54
  Sfx.Play 0, 200, -6, 15, 25, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a game
Sub Game()
  score = 0 : lives = 3 : wave = 1 : over = 0 : smart = 3 : nextLife = 10000 : cloak = 200
  planetGone = 0
  power = 1 : pNext = 0 : pAll = 0 : guards = 3 : guardT = 0 : chain = 0 : chainT = 0
  level = 1 : saved = 0 : bossDone = 0 : nuMax = NU
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    ps(k) = 1
  Next
  Do
    WaveRun
    If over Then Exit Do
    ' every third level: a boss
    If level \ 3 > bossDone Then
      BossRun
      If over Then Exit Do
    End If
    If warp Then wave = wave + 3 Else wave = wave + 1
  Loop
  Nx.PalEntry 1, 0, 0
  If score > hiscore Then hiscore = score
  Message "GAME OVER", 14, 0
  For k = 1 To 250
    Frame
    Land.Upload
    Sfx.Update
    If k > 50 And FireDown() Then Exit For
  Next
  ClearMessages
End Sub

' the humanoids back (the start, and waves 6, 11, 16 ...): spread along the ground
Sub People()
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    ps(k) = 1 : px(k) = k * (WORLD \ NP) + Rnd(100) : py(k) = GY : pd(k) = 1 - 2 * Rnd(2) : pv(k) = 0
  Next
End Sub

Function PeopleLeft() As Integer
  Dim n As Integer
  n = 0
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    If ps(k) Then n = n + 1
  Next
  PeopleLeft = n
End Function

Function OnGround() As Integer
  Dim n As Integer
  n = 0
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    If ps(k) = 1 Then n = n + 1
  Next
  OnGround = n
End Function

' this wave's line up (Stargate's own)
Sub LineUp()
  For k = 0 To 14
    q(k) = 0
  Next
  If wave Mod 10 = 5 Then
    ' the Yllabian Dogfight
    q(K_DYNAMO) = 6 : q(K_GUPPY) = 22 : q(K_SWARM) = 8
  ElseIf wave Mod 10 = 0 Then
    ' the Firebomber Showdown
    q(K_FIREB) = 13 : q(K_POD) = 6
  ElseIf wave = 1 Then
    q(K_LANDER) = 11 : q(K_DYNAMO) = 2 : q(K_FIREB) = 3
  ElseIf wave = 2 Then
    q(K_LANDER) = 10 : q(K_DYNAMO) = 2 : q(K_FIREB) = 3 : q(K_GUPPY) = 7
  ElseIf wave = 3 Then
    q(K_LANDER) = 10 : q(K_DYNAMO) = 2 : q(K_FIREB) = 6 : q(K_GUPPY) = 4 : q(K_POD) = 3
  ElseIf wave < 11 Then
    q(K_LANDER) = 17 : q(K_DYNAMO) = 3 : q(K_FIREB) = 3 : q(K_GUPPY) = 5 : q(K_POD) = 4
    If wave = 6 Then q(K_BOMBER) = 2
    If wave > 6 Then q(K_BOMBER) = 3
  Else
    q(K_LANDER) = 18 : q(K_DYNAMO) = 4 : q(K_FIREB) = 4 : q(K_GUPPY) = 3 : q(K_POD) = 4 : q(K_BOMBER) = 2
  End If
End Sub

Function ToCome() As Integer
  Dim n As Integer
  n = 0
  For k = 1 To 14
    n = n + q(k)
  Next
  ToCome = n
End Function

Function FreeSlots() As Integer
  Dim n As Integer, c As Integer
  c = 0
  For n = 0 To nuMax - 1
    If uk(n) = 0 Then c = c + 1
  Next
  FreeSlots = c
End Function

' one more of the others (not landers) in, if there's room
Sub Arrive()
  Dim kd As Integer
  If FreeSlots() < 7 Then Exit Sub
  For kd = 2 To 14
    If q(kd) > 0 Then
      q(kd) = q(kd) - 1
      NewUFO kd
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub WaveRun()
  Dim b As Long, t As Integer, clearT As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 54
  Bul.Reset
  Nx.PalEntry 1, 0, 0
  For k = 0 To NB - 1
    bt(k) = 0
  Next
  For k = 0 To NU - 1
    uk(k) = 0 : ub(k) = -1
  Next
  For k = 0 To NBOX - 1
    bo(k) = -1
  Next
  ItemsClear
  nuMax = NU
  If wave = 1 Or wave Mod 5 = 1 Or (warp And planetGone) Then
    If planetGone Or wave > 1 Then Message "THE PLANET IS RESTORED", 17, 100
    People
    planetGone = 0
  Else
    ' the survivors back on the ground
    For k = 0 To NP - 1
      If ps(k) Then ps(k) = 1 : py(k) = GY
    Next
  End If
  For k = 0 To NP - 1
    pb(k) = -1
  Next
  Land.Kill planetGone
  warp = 0
  LineUp
  ' the first landers, five; the rest of the line up as room allows
  For k = 1 To 5
    If q(K_LANDER) > 0 Then q(K_LANDER) = q(K_LANDER) - 1 : NewUFO K_LANDER
  Next
  For k = 1 To 14
    Arrive
  Next
  hx = 200 * 8 : hy = 100 : hvx = 0 : face = 1 : alive = 1 : safe = 100 : deadT = 0 : cool = 0 : smartT = 0
  aboard = 0 : catches = 0 : cloakOn = 0 : gateT = 0 : chaser = 0
  smartWas = 1 : hyperWas = 1 : hyperT = 0
  camX = 112 : pan = 0 : waveT = 0 : clearT = 0
  Hud
  Message "ATTACK WAVE " & Trim$(Str$(wave)), 13, 100
  If wave Mod 10 = 5 Then
    Message "YLLABIAN DOGFIGHT!", 15, 100
  ElseIf wave Mod 10 = 0 Then
    Message "FIREBOMBER SHOWDOWN!", 15, 100
  ElseIf planetGone Then
    Message "NO PLANET: MUTANTS!", 15, 100
  End If
  Do
    waveT = waveT + 1
    If waveT > 30000 Then waveT = 20000
    ' more landers, five at a time; the others as room allows
    If (waveT Mod 10) = 1 Then att = Attackers() : tc = ToCome()
    If q(K_LANDER) > 0 And ((waveT Mod 600) = 0 Or (att < 5 And (waveT Mod 50) = 0)) Then
      For k = 1 To 5
        If q(K_LANDER) > 0 And FreeSlots() > 4 Then q(K_LANDER) = q(K_LANDER) - 1 : NewUFO K_LANDER
      Next
    End If
    If (waveT Mod 40) = 20 Then Arrive
    ' too slow: a baiter, then Phred and Big Red
    If waveT > 2000 And (waveT Mod 450) = 0 Then
      chaser = chaser + 1
      If chaser Mod 3 = 1 Then
        NewUFO K_BAITER
      ElseIf chaser Mod 3 = 2 Then
        NewUFO K_PHRED
      Else
        NewUFO K_BIGRED
      End If
    End If
    You
    me = hx \ 8
    Camera
    UFOs
    Folk
    Gate
    Booms
    Items
    SmartUpdate
    Hell
    If alive And hyperT = 0 Then Bul.Step Sx(me), hy + 1, pan Else Bul.Step 0, 0, pan
    If alive And safe = 0 And smartT = 0 And cloakOn = 0 And hyperT = 0 And guardT = 0 Then
      If Bul.Hit() Then Die
    End If
    DrawShip
    Scanner
    If scoreDirty And (frames And 3) = 0 Then ShowScore
    If statsDirty And (frames And 3) = 2 Then ShowStats
    If msgT > 0 Then
      msgT = msgT - 1
      If msgT = 0 Then ClearMessages
    End If
    If (frames And 15) = 0 Then Land.Twinkle frames \ 16
    Land.View camX
    Frame
    Land.Upload
    Spr.Show
    Bul.Show
    Sfx.Update
    Tick
    If alive = 0 And deadT = 0 And lives = 0 Then over = 1 : Exit Sub
    If warp Then
      ' through the Stargate with four aboard: three waves on
      t = PeopleLeft()
      SaveFolk t
      b = CLng(t) * 2000

      AddScore b

      Spr.HideRange 0, 54

      Bul.Reset : Bul.Show : Spr.Show

      Message "BONUS " & Trim$(Str$(b)), 14, 0
      For k = 1 To 150

    If tc = 0 And att = 0 And waveT > 10 Then

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- you
Sub You()
  Dim j0 As Integer, mx As Integer, my As Integer, v As Integer, sb As Integer, n As Integer
  If alive = 0 Then
    If deadT > 0 Then
      deadT = deadT - 1
      If deadT = 0 And lives > 0 Then
        alive = 1 : safe = 150 : hy = 100 : hvx = 0 : ShowLives
      End If
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  ' hyperspace: gone for a moment, then somewhere else (and maybe in pieces)
  If hyperT > 0 Then
    hyperT = hyperT - 1
    If hyperT = 0 Then
      hx = Rnd(WORLD) * 8 : hy = YTOP + Rnd(YLOW - YTOP) : hvx = 0
      camX = Wrap(hx \ 8 - 88) : face = 1 : pan = 0
      Spr.Hide SP_GATE
      If Rnd(5) = 0 Then Die
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  j0 = Keys.Joystick(0)
  mx = 0 : my = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyLeft) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyLeft) Then mx = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyRight) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyRight) Then mx = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyUp) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyUp) Then my = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyDown) Or (j0 And Keys.JoyDown) Then my = 1
  thrust = 0
  If mx <> 0 Then
    ' turn, and thrust
    face = mx : thrust = 1
    hvx = hvx + mx * 3
    If hvx > 52 Then hvx = 52
    If hvx < -52 Then hvx = -52
  Else
    If hvx > 0 Then hvx = hvx - 1
    If hvx < 0 Then hvx = hvx + 1
  End If
  hx = (hx + hvx + WORLD * 8) And (WORLD * 8 - 1)
  hy = hy + my * 3
  If hy < YTOP Then hy = YTOP
  If hy > YLOW Then hy = YLOW
  ' the laser
  If cool > 0 Then cool = cool - 1
  If FireDown() And cool = 0 Then
    Lasers
    Sfx.Play 0, 24, 3, 10, 4, 0
  End If
  ' the guard
  sb = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyG)
  If sb And guardWas = 0 And guards > 0 And guardT = 0 Then
    guards = guards - 1 : statsDirty = 1
    guardT = 100
    GuardEat
    Sfx.Play 1, 500, -20, 14, 40, 0
  End If
  guardWas = sb
  ' a smart bomb
  sb = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyB) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyEnter) Or ((j0 And Keys.JoyFire2) <> 0)
  If sb And smartWas = 0 And smart > 0 And smartT = 0 Then
    smart = smart - 1 : ShowLives
    smartT = 40
    SmartBomb
    Sfx.Play 2, 31, 0, 15, 60, 1
  End If
  smartWas = sb
  ' Inviso: while it's held and there's some left
  If (Keys.Down(Keys.KeyI) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyN)) And cloak > 0 Then
    If cloakOn = 0 Then Sfx.Play 1, 300, -8, 11, 20, 0
    cloakOn = 1 : cloak = cloak - 1
    If (cloak Mod 40) = 0 Then ShowCloak
  Else
    If cloakOn Then ShowCloak
    cloakOn = 0
  End If
  ' hyperspace
  sb = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyH)
  If sb And hyperWas = 0 Then
    hyperT = 30
    Spr.Put SP_GATE, Sx(hx \ 8) + 16, hy + 16, GfxData.S_STARS, Spr.Scale2
    DropAll
    Sfx.Play 1, 20, 6, 14, 30, 0
  End If
  hyperWas = sb
  If safe > 0 Then safe = safe - 1
  ' down on the ground with humanoids aboard: they get off
  If aboard > 0 And hy >= YLOW - 2 Then
    For n = 0 To NP - 1
      If ps(n) = 4 Then
        ps(n) = 1 : py(n) = GY : px(n) = Wrap(hx \ 8 - face * (8 + pa(n) * 6))
        AddScore 500
      End If
    Next
    Message Trim$(Str$(aboard * 500)), 20, 50
    Sfx.Play 1, 80, -3, 14, 20, 0
    aboard = 0 : catches = 0
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the Stargate
Sub Gate()
  Dim x As Integer, n As Integer, best As Integer, by_ As Integer
  If gateT > 0 Then gateT = gateT - 1
  x = Sx(GATEX)
  If x > -24 And x < 280 Then
    If (frames And 4) Then n = Spr.Pal * 7 Else n = 0
    Spr.Put SP_GATE, x + 16, GATEY + 16, GfxData.S_GATE + ((frames \ 4) And 1), Spr.Scale2 + n
  ElseIf hyperT = 0 Then
    Spr.Hide SP_GATE
  End If
  If alive = 0 Or hyperT > 0 Or gateT > 0 Then Exit Sub
  If Abs(Dif(GATEX, me)) > 12 Or Abs(hy - GATEY) > 12 Then Exit Sub
  ' in!
  gateT = 120
  Sfx.Play 1, 30, 8, 15, 40, 0
  Sfx.Play 0, 400, -12, 13, 40, 0
  If aboard >= 4 And wave < 10 And face > 0 Then
    warp = 1
    Exit Sub
  End If
  ' a humanoid falling, then one being carried off (the one nearest the top), else the far side
  best = -1 : by_ = 999
  For n = 0 To NP - 1
    If ps(n) = 3 And best < 0 Then best = n
  Next
  If best >= 0 Then
    hx = Wrap(px(best) - face * 60) * 8 : hy = py(best) - 10
  Else
    For n = 0 To NU - 1
      If uk(n) = K_LANDER And ug(n) >= 0 Then
        If uy(n) < by_ Then by_ = uy(n) : best = n
      End If
    Next
    If best >= 0 Then
      hx = Wrap(ux(best) - face * 70) * 8 : hy = uy(best)
    Else
      hx = Wrap(hx \ 8 + HALF) * 8
    End If
  End If
  If hy < YTOP Then hy = YTOP
  If hy > YLOW Then hy = YLOW
  If face > 0 Then camX = Wrap(hx \ 8 - 72) Else camX = Wrap(hx \ 8 - 184)
  pan = 0 : me = hx \ 8
  k = Bul.Clear()
  smartT = 12
  Message "STARGATE", 20, 40
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the enemies
Sub NewUFO(ByVal kd As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer, m As Integer
  m = -1
  For n = 0 To nuMax - 1
    If uk(n) = 0 And m < 0 Then m = n
  Next
  If m < 0 Then Exit Sub
  If kd = K_LANDER And planetGone Then kd = K_MUTANT
  uk(m) = kd : ug(m) = -1 : ut(m) = Rnd(100) : ufr(m) = 0 : ub(m) = -1 : utg(m) = -1
  uf(m) = 60 + Rnd(120)
  ' somewhere off the screen
  ux(m) = Wrap(camX + 300 + Rnd(WORLD - 600))
  uy(m) = 56 + Rnd(70)
  uvx(m) = 4 + Rnd(6)
  If Rnd(2) Then uvx(m) = -uvx(m)
  uvy(m) = 0
  Select Case kd
    Case K_BAITER, K_PHRED, K_BIGRED
      ux(m) = Wrap(hx \ 8 + 220 * face) : uy(m) = hy
    Case K_GUPPY
      uvx(m) = 0 : uvy(m) = 0
    Case K_FIREB
      uvx(m) = 12 : uvy(m) = 1
      If Rnd(2) Then uvx(m) = -12
    Case K_SWARM
      uvx(m) = 0
    Case K_BOMBER, K_POD, K_DYNAMO
      uvx(m) = uvx(m) \ 2
  End Select
End Sub

' a child (swarmer, fireball, hum, munchie) from x, y: its slot or -1
Function Spawn(ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
  Dim n As Integer
  Spawn = -1
  For n = 0 To nuMax - 1
    If uk(n) = 0 Then
      uk(n) = kd : ux(n) = Wrap(x) : uy(n) = y : uvx(n) = 0 : uvy(n) = 0
      ut(n) = 0 : ug(n) = -1 : uf(n) = 40 + Rnd(60) : ufr(n) = 0 : ub(n) = -1
      Spawn = n
      Exit Function
    End If
  Next
End Function

Sub KillUFO(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim pts As Long, j As Integer
  Boom ux(n), uy(n)
  Select Case uk(n)
    Case K_LANDER, K_MUTANT, K_SWARM
      pts = 150
    Case K_BOMBER, K_FIREB
      pts = 250
    Case K_POD
      pts = 1000
    Case K_FIREBALL, K_HUM
      pts = 100
    Case K_MUNCH
      pts = 50
    Case Else
      pts = 200
  End Select
  ' a lander with someone: they fall
  If ug(n) >= 0 Then
    j = ug(n)
    ps(j) = 3 : pv(j) = 0 : pf(j) = py(j)
    ug(n) = -1
  End If
  ' a pod: swarmers
  If uk(n) = K_POD Then
    For j = 1 To 4 + Rnd(4)
      k = Spawn(K_SWARM, ux(n) + Rnd(16) - 8, uy(n) + Rnd(16) - 8)
    Next
  End If
  ' the HIT chain: each kill while it lasts is worth more; and a pickup maybe
  chain = chain + 1 : chainT = 90 : statsDirty = 1
  pts = pts + (chain - 1) * 10
  Drop n
  uk(n) = 0
  BoxFree ub(n) : ub(n) = -1
  Spr.Hide SP_UFO + n
  AddScore pts
  Sfx.Play 2, 20 + Rnd(10), 4, 14, 18, 1
End Sub

Sub UFOs()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer, h As Integer, d As Integer, pat As Integer, fl As Integer, j As Integer
  Dim best As Integer, bd As Integer, hw As Integer, hh As Integer, sx_ As Integer
  sx_ = Sx(me)
  For n = 0 To NU - 1
    If uk(n) Then
      ut(n) = ut(n) + 1
      If ut(n) > 30000 Then ut(n) = 0
      ' shot?
      If ub(n) >= 0 Then
        h = Bul.Hits(ub(n))
        If h > 0 Then KillUFO n
      End If
    End If
    If uk(n) Then
      d = Dif(ux(n), me)                     ' you, from it
      hw = 7 : hh = 6 : fl = 0
      Select Case uk(n)
        Case K_LANDER
          If ug(n) >= 0 Then
            ' going up with someone
            If (ut(n) And 1) = 0 Then uy(n) = uy(n) - 1
            j = ug(n) : px(j) = ux(n) : py(j) = uy(n) + 12
            If uy(n) <= YTOP - 6 Then
              ' at the top: they're gone, and it's a mutant now
              ps(j) = 0 : ug(n) = -1 : uk(n) = K_MUTANT
              Spr.Hide SP_PEOPLE + j
              BoxFree pb(j) : pb(j) = -1
              Message "MUTANT!", 20, 40
              Sfx.Play 1, 200, 20, 14, 30, 0
              If PeopleLeft() = 0 Then PlanetGoes
            End If
          Else
            ' drifting; now and then it picks someone on the ground below
            MoveX n
            ' (looked for every 16 frames: the nearest on the ground, close by)
            best = utg(n)
            If best >= 0 Then
              If ps(best) <> 1 Then best = -1
            End If
            If (ut(n) And 15) = 0 Then
              best = -1 : bd = 40
              For j = 0 To NP - 1
                If ps(j) = 1 Then
                  h = Abs(Dif(ux(n), px(j)))
                  If h < bd Then bd = h : best = j
                End If
              Next
            End If
            utg(n) = best
            If best < 0 Or (ut(n) And 511) < 150 Then
              ' no one below (or not yet): wander up and down
              If (ut(n) And 31) = 0 Then uvy(n) = Rnd(3) - 1
              uy(n) = uy(n) + uvy(n)
              If uy(n) < 56 Then uy(n) = 56
              If uy(n) > 130 Then uy(n) = 130
            ElseIf (ut(n) And 1) = 0 Then
              ' down to them
              ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + Sgn(Dif(ux(n), px(best))))
              If uy(n) < GY - 12 Then uy(n) = uy(n) + 1
              If uy(n) >= GY - 12 And Abs(Dif(ux(n), px(best))) < 3 Then
                ug(n) = best : ps(best) = 2
                Sfx.Play 1, 400, -20, 13, 30, 0
                If OnGround() = 0 Then
                  Message "PLANET SURFACE UNSTABLE!", 18, 100
                ElseIf Abs(Sx(ux(n))) < 300 Then
                  Message "HUMANOID!", 20, 40
                End If
              End If
            End If
          End If
          pat = GfxData.S_LANDER - ((ut(n) And 8) <> 0)
          If (uf(n) <= 0) Then Shoot n, 14 + wave, 0
        Case K_MUTANT
          ' straight at you, jittering
          If (ut(n) And 1) = 0 Then
            ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + Sgn(d) * 3 + Rnd(3) - 1)
            uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - uy(n)) * 2 + Rnd(5) - 2
          End If
          If uy(n) < YTOP Then uy(n) = YTOP
          If uy(n) > YLOW Then uy(n) = YLOW
          pat = GfxData.S_MUTANT - ((ut(n) And 4) <> 0)
          If (ut(n) And 4) Then fl = Spr.Pal * 5
          If (uf(n) <= 0) Then Shoot n, 18 + wave, 1
        Case K_BOMBER
          MoveX n
          uy(n) = 90 + sn2((ut(n)) And 127)
          If (ut(n) And 31) = 0 And Sx(ux(n)) > 8 And Sx(ux(n)) < 248 Then Bul.Fire Sx(ux(n)), uy(n), 0, 0, GfxData.S_MINE, 0
          pat = GfxData.S_BOMBER - ((ut(n) And 8) <> 0)
        Case K_POD
          MoveX n
          uy(n) = 80 + sn4((ut(n) + n * 30) And 127)
          pat = GfxData.S_POD - ((ut(n) And 8) <> 0)
        Case K_SWARM
          ' fast at you across, overshooting, undulating
          uvx(n) = uvx(n) + Sgn(d)
          If uvx(n) > 30 Then uvx(n) = 30
          If uvx(n) < -30 Then uvx(n) = -30
          MoveX n
          uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - uy(n)) + sn32((ut(n) * 4) And 127)
          If uy(n) < YTOP Then uy(n) = YTOP
          If uy(n) > YLOW Then uy(n) = YLOW
          pat = GfxData.S_SWARMER - ((ut(n) And 4) <> 0) : hw = 5 : hh = 4
          If (uf(n) <= 0) Then Shoot n, 20, 0
        Case K_BAITER
          ' keeps up with you, and shoots straight
          ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + Sgn(d) * 3 + hvx \ 8)
          uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - 20 - uy(n))
          pat = GfxData.S_BAITER - ((ut(n) And 4) <> 0) : hh = 3
          If (uf(n) <= 0) Then Shoot n, 26, 0 : uf(n) = 30 + Rnd(30)
        Case K_FIREB
          ' zig zag; from wave 2, fireballs
          MoveX n
          uy(n) = uy(n) + uvy(n)
          If (ut(n) And 63) = 0 Then
            uvy(n) = Rnd(2) * 2 - 1
            If Rnd(3) = 0 Then uvx(n) = -uvx(n)
          End If
          If uy(n) < 56 Then uvy(n) = 1
          If uy(n) > 150 Then uvy(n) = -1
          pat = GfxData.S_FIREB - ((ut(n) And 4) <> 0)
          If uf(n) <= 0 Then
            uf(n) = 90 + Rnd(90) - wave * 4
            If uf(n) < 40 Then uf(n) = 40
            If wave >= 2 And Abs(Sx(ux(n)) - 128) < 128 And alive Then Fireball n
          End If
        Case K_FIREBALL
          ' straight on, then gone
          MoveX n
          uy(n) = uy(n) + uvy(n)
          pat = GfxData.S_FIREBALL - ((ut(n) And 2) <> 0) : hw = 4 : hh = 4
          If ut(n) > 100 Or uy(n) < YTOP Or uy(n) > YLOW + 8 Then
            uk(n) = 0 : BoxFree ub(n) : ub(n) = -1 : Spr.Hide SP_UFO + n
          End If
        Case K_DYNAMO
          ' drifts; sheds space hums
          MoveX n
          uy(n) = 96 + sn2((ut(n) + n * 20) And 127)
          pat = GfxData.S_DYNAMO - ((ut(n) And 8) <> 0)
          If uf(n) <= 0 Then
            uf(n) = 150 + Rnd(100)
            If Abs(Sx(ux(n)) - 128) < 200 And FreeSlots() > 3 Then
              j = Spawn(K_HUM, ux(n), uy(n))
              If j >= 0 Then Sfx.Play 1, 40, -2, 11, 10, 0
            End If
          End If
        Case K_HUM
          ' after you, wobbling
          If (ut(n) And 1) = 0 Then
            ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + Sgn(d) * 2 + Rnd(3) - 1)
            uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - uy(n)) + Rnd(3) - 1
          End If
          pat = GfxData.S_HUM - ((ut(n) And 2) <> 0) : hw = 4 : hh = 4
        Case K_GUPPY
          ' a swarm, homing in, wiggling
          uvx(n) = uvx(n) + Sgn(d)
          If uvx(n) > 22 Then uvx(n) = 22
          If uvx(n) < -22 Then uvx(n) = -22
          MoveX n
          If (ut(n) And 1) = 0 Then uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - uy(n))
          uy(n) = uy(n) + sn24((ut(n) * 3 + n * 16) And 127)
          If uy(n) < YTOP Then uy(n) = YTOP
          If uy(n) > YLOW Then uy(n) = YLOW
          pat = GfxData.S_GUPPY - ((ut(n) And 4) <> 0)
          If uvx(n) < 0 Then fl = Spr.MirrorX
          If (uf(n) <= 0) Then Shoot n, 16 + wave, 0 : uf(n) = uf(n) + 60
        Case K_PHRED, K_BIGRED
          ' fast after you; spits munchies
          ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + Sgn(d) * 3 + hvx \ 16)
          uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - uy(n))
          pat = GfxData.S_PHRED - ((ut(n) And 4) <> 0)
          If d < 0 Then fl = Spr.MirrorX
          If uk(n) = K_BIGRED Then fl = fl + Spr.Pal * 6
          If uf(n) <= 0 Then
            uf(n) = 90 + Rnd(60)
            If FreeSlots() > 3 Then j = Spawn(K_MUNCH, ux(n), uy(n))
          End If
        Case K_MUNCH
          ' small, quick, after you
          ux(n) = Wrap(ux(n) + Sgn(d) * 2 + Sgn(d) * (ut(n) And 1))
          uy(n) = uy(n) + Sgn(hy - uy(n))
          pat = GfxData.S_MUNCHIE - ((ut(n) And 4) <> 0) : hw = 4 : hh = 4
          If d < 0 Then fl = Spr.MirrorX
          If ut(n) > 600 Then uk(n) = 0 : BoxFree ub(n) : ub(n) = -1 : Spr.Hide SP_UFO + n
      End Select
      uf(n) = uf(n) - 1
    End If
    If uk(n) Then
      ' on the screen: the sprite, the target box; you running into it
      x = Sx(ux(n))
      If x > -16 And x < 272 Then
        Spr.Put SP_UFO + n, x + 24, uy(n) + 24, pat, fl
        If x > 2 And x < 254 Then

        End If

End Sub

' enemy n moves across uvx(n) eighths of a pixel (its eighths kept in ufr)
Sub MoveX(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim f As Integer, m As Integer
  f = ufr(n) + uvx(n) : m = 0
  Do While f >= 8
    f = f - 8 : m = m + 1
  Loop
  Do While f <= -8
    f = f + 8 : m = m - 1
  Loop
  ufr(n) = f
  If m Then ux(n) = (ux(n) + m + WORLD) And (WORLD - 1)
End Sub

' a firebomber throws a fireball at you
Sub Fireball(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer, d As Integer
  j = Spawn(K_FIREBALL, ux(n), uy(n))
  If j < 0 Then Exit Sub
  d = Dif(ux(n), hx \ 8)
  uvx(j) = Sgn(d) * (24 + wave * 2)
  If uvx(j) > 40 Then uvx(j) = 40
  If uvx(j) < -40 Then uvx(j) = -40
  uvy(j) = Sgn(hy - uy(n))
  Sfx.Play 1, 60, 6, 12, 12, 0
End Sub

' a sine wave: -64 .. 64 over 128 frames
Function Sine1(ByVal t As Integer) As Integer
  Dim u As Integer
  u = t And 127
  If u < 64 Then Sine1 = u * 2 - 64 Else Sine1 = 192 - u * 2
End Function

' enemy n shoots at you (if it's on the screen): kind 0 one bullet, 1 a pair, 2 a fan of 3
Sub Shoot(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal sp As Integer, ByVal kind As Integer)
  Dim x As Integer, a As Integer
  uf(n) = 80 + Rnd(80) - wave * 3 - level * 4
  If uf(n) < 18 Then uf(n) = 18
  sp = sp + level \ 2
  If kind = 0 And level >= 4 Then kind = 1
  If kind = 1 And level >= 7 Then kind = 2
  If alive = 0 Or hyperT > 0 Then Exit Sub
  x = Sx(ux(n))
  If x < 0 Or x > 256 Then Exit Sub
  If Abs(x - Sx(me)) < 20 Then Exit Sub        ' (not point blank)
  a = Bul.Aim(x, uy(n), Sx(me), hy)
  If kind = 0 Then
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), a, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
  ElseIf kind = 1 Then
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), a, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), (a + 8) And 255, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
  Else
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), a, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, BLUE
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), (a + 14) And 255, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, BLUE
    Bul.Fire x, uy(n), (a - 14) And 255, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, BLUE
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the humanoids
Sub Folk()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer, pat As Integer, fl As Integer, j As Integer
  For n = 0 To NP - 1
    ' shot by your laser (carried up, or falling)?
    If pb(n) >= 0 Then

        Else
          BoxFree pb(n) : pb(n) = -1
        End If

        BoxFree pb(n) : pb(n) = -1
      End If

      BoxFree pb(n) : pb(n) = -1

  Dim n As Integer, dx As Integer, dy As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, f As Integer, pull As Integer
  For n = 0 To NI - 1
    If ik(n) Then
      ia(n) = ia(n) + 1

        If (Abs(dx) < 48 And Abs(dy) < 40) Or guardT > 0 Then pull = 1
      End If
      If pull Then
        ivx(n) = dx * 16 : ivy(n) = dy * 16
        If dx > 5 Then ivx(n) = 80
        If dx < -5 Then ivx(n) = -80
        If dy > 5 Then ivy(n) = 80
        If dy < -5 Then ivy(n) = -80
      Else
        If ivy(n) < 10 Then ivy(n) = ivy(n) + 2
        ivx(n) = ivx(n) - ivx(n) \ 8
      End If
      ix(n) = Wrap(ix(n) + ivx(n) \ 16) : iy(n) = iy(n) + ivy(n)
      y = iy(n) \ 16
      If y < YTOP Then iy(n) = YTOP * 16 : ivy(n) = 0
      x = Sx(ix(n))
      If y > GY Or ia(n) > 500 Then
        ik(n) = 0 : Spr.Hide SP_ITEM + n

        Pick ik(n)
        ik(n) = 0 : Spr.Hide SP_ITEM + n
      ElseIf x > -16 And x < 272 And (ia(n) < 400 Or (frames And 2) <> 0) Then
        If ik(n) = 1 Then
          f = GfxData.S_ITEM + (((frames \ 4) + n) And 3)
        ElseIf ik(n) = 2 Then
          f = GfxData.S_BIGP + ((frames \ 8) And 1)
        Else
          f = GfxData.S_GEM + (((frames \ 6) + n) And 1)
        End If
        Spr.Put SP_ITEM + n, x + 24, y + 24, f, Spr.Pal * PAL_ITEM
      Else
        Spr.Hide SP_ITEM + n
      End If
    End If
  Next

' the boss: moves, shoots by phase, takes hits, dies
Sub Boss()
  Dim want As Integer, h As Integer, a As Integer, ph As Integer, sp As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, fl As Integer, j As Integer
  bossT = bossT + 1
  If bossT > 30000 Then bossT = 1000
  If bossDie > 1 Then
    ' going down: explosions, then gone
    bossDie = bossDie - 1
    If (bossDie And 3) = 0 Then
      Boom Wrap(camX + bsx - 32 + Rnd(64)), bsy - 20 + Rnd(40)
      Sfx.Play 2, 20 + Rnd(20), 4, 15, 12, 1
    End If
    If (bossDie And 4) Then DrawBoss Spr.Pal Else DrawBoss Spr.Pal * (PAL_BOSS + (bossN - 1) Mod 5)
    If bossDie = 1 Then Spr.HideRange SP_BOSS, 12
    Exit Sub
  End If
  ' in front of you, bobbing
  If face > 0 Then want = 196 Else want = 60
  bsx = bsx + Sgn(want - bsx) * (1 - (Abs(want - bsx) > 40))     ' (2 a frame when far, 1 close)
  bsy = 96 + sn2((bossT \ 2) And 127) \ 2 + sn4((bossT \ 3) And 127)
  ' hit?
  If bossBox < 0 Then bossBox = BoxFor(200)
  If bossBox >= 0 Then
    Bul.Box bossBox, bsx, bsy, 28, 20
    h = Bul.Hits(bossBox)
    If h > 0 Then
      bossHP = bossHP - h : bossFl = 4
      AddScore CLng(h) * 10
      If bossHP <= 0 Then BossDown : Exit Sub
    End If
  End If
  If smartT = 39 Then
    bossHP = bossHP - 15 : bossFl = 8
    If bossHP <= 0 Then BossDown : Exit Sub
  End If
  fl = Spr.Pal * (PAL_BOSS + (bossN - 1) Mod 5)
  If bossFl > 0 Then bossFl = bossFl - 1 : fl = Spr.Pal
  DrawBoss fl
  ' running into it
  If alive And hyperT = 0 And safe = 0 And cloakOn = 0 Then
    If Abs(Sx(me) - bsx) < 26 And Abs(hy - bsy) < 20 Then Die
  End If
  ' the guns: three phases as it gets hurt
  If alive = 0 Or hyperT > 0 Or bossT < 60 Then Exit Sub
  If bossHP * 3 > bossMax * 2 Then
    ph = 1
  ElseIf bossHP * 3 > bossMax Then
    ph = 2
  Else
    ph = 3
  End If
  sp = 14 + bossN + level \ 3
  x = bsx : y = bsy + 8
  a = Bul.Aim(x, y, Sx(me), hy)
  Select Case ph
    Case 1
      If (bossT Mod (50 - bossN * 2)) = 0 Then
        For j = -2 To 2
          Bul.Fire x, y, (a + j * 8) And 255, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
        Next
      End If
      If (bossT Mod 110) = 55 Then Ring x, y, 10 + bossN, bossT And 31, sp - 4, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, BLUE
    Case 2
      If (bossT Mod 5) = 0 Then
        Bul.Fire x, y, (bossT * 7) And 255, sp - 2, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
        Bul.Fire x, y, (bossT * 7 + 128) And 255, sp - 2, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
      End If
      If (bossT Mod 70) = 0 Then
        For j = -1 To 1
          Bul.Fire x, y, (a + j * 6) And 255, sp + 8, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, BLUE
        Next
      End If
    Case Else
      If (bossT Mod 45) = 0 Then Ring x, y, 14 + bossN, (bossT \ 45) * 9, sp - 4, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, BLUE
      If (bossT Mod 28) = 14 Then
        For j = -1 To 1
          Bul.Fire x, y, (a + j * 10) And 255, sp + 10, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
        Next
      End If
      If (bossT Mod 9) = 0 Then Bul.Fire x, y, (bossT * 11) And 255, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET, PINK
  End Select
  If (bossT Mod 60) = 0 Then Sfx.Play 1, 90, 2, 11, 10, 0
End Sub

  BoxFree bossBox : bossBox = -1
  k = Bul.Clear()
  pts = CLng(bossN) * 10000
  AddScore pts

  Message "BONUS " & Trim$(Str$(pts)), 14, 0
  For j = 1 To 4

' the boss's 12 sprites (4 x 3): its left half, and the same mirrored for the right
Sub DrawBoss(ByVal fl As Integer)
  Dim cx As Integer, cy As Integer, b As Integer, y As Integer
  b = GfxData.S_BOSS1 + ((bossN - 1) Mod 5) * 6
  For cy = 0 To 2
    y = bsy - 24 + cy * 16 + 32
    For cx = 0 To 3
      If cx < 2 Then

        Spr.Put SP_BOSS + cy * 4 + cx, bsx + cx * 16, y, b + cy * 2 + 3 - cx, fl Or Spr.MirrorX
      End If
    Next
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub
